amenities.name: Swimming Pool
amenities.description: Outdoor heated pool on the 3rd-floor terrace, open daily 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM. Towels provided poolside.

amenities.name: Free Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms, the lobby, and the pool deck.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.description: Complimentary self-parking for hotel guests in the on-site basement garage, subject to availability.

amenities.name: Breakfast
amenities.description: Complimentary breakfast buffet served daily 7:00 AM - 10:30 AM in the Harborview Restaurant, included with every room booking.

amenities.name: Fitness Center
amenities.description: 24-hour gym on the 2nd floor with cardio machines and free weights, accessible with your room key.

amenities.name: Airport Shuttle
amenities.description: Paid shuttle service to and from the airport, available on request at the front desk, subject to schedule.

rooms.description: One queen bed, city view, 24 sq. m. Suitable for solo travelers or couples.
One king bed plus a daybed, partial sea view, 30 sq. m. Suitable for small families or up to 3 adults.
Separate living area, two queen beds, full sea view, 45 sq. m. Suitable for families of up to 4.
Two connecting rooms, one king bed and two twin beds, 58 sq. m. total. Suitable for larger families of up to 5.

cancellationPolicy.summary: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in; cancellations within 48 hours are charged one night's stay.
cancellationPolicy.details: Guests may cancel or modify a reservation free of charge up to 48 hours before the scheduled check-in date. Cancellations made within 48 hours of check-in, or no-shows, will be charged the cost of the first night. Refunds for eligible cancellations are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Yes, a complimentary breakfast buffet is included with every room booking, served 7:00 AM - 10:30 AM.

faqs.question: Do you allow pets?
faqs.answer: The hotel does not allow pets, with the exception of registered service animals.

faqs.question: What is the minimum check-in age?
faqs.answer: Guests must be at least 18 years old to check in without a parent or guardian present.

faqs.question: Is early check-in or late check-out available?
faqs.answer: Early check-in and late check-out are available on request and subject to room availability; a fee may apply for late check-out.

faqs.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
faqs.answer: Yes, a paid airport shuttle is available on request at the front desk, subject to schedule.

faqs.question: Is smoking allowed in the rooms?
faqs.answer: All guest rooms are non-smoking. Designated smoking areas are available outside the main entrance.
